questions.prompt_en: We want to know which school lunch pupils prefer. Which data should we collect: favourite lunch, shoe size or journey time to school? Explain.
questions.prompt_cn: 我们想知道学生最喜欢哪种学校午餐。应该收集哪类数据：最喜欢的午餐、鞋码，还是上学所需时间？请解释。
questions.expected_core: Collect favourite-lunch responses because the data must answer the investigation question.

questions.prompt_en: A survey groups ages as 6-8, 8-10 and 10-12. What problem could this cause? How would you fix the categories?
questions.prompt_cn: 一项调查把年龄分成6-8岁、8-10岁、10-12岁。这样分类有什么问题？怎样修改？
questions.expected_core: Boundary ages such as 8 and 10 fit two groups; categories should be non-overlapping and cover all responses.
follow_ups: Why must each response have one clear place?

questions.prompt_en: A pictogram key says one star represents 5 pupils. A row has 3 stars. How many pupils does it represent? Explain how the key changes the count.
questions.prompt_cn: 象形统计图的图例说明1颗星代表5名学生。一行有3颗星，表示多少名学生？请说明图例怎样影响读数。

questions.prompt_en: A graph shows temperature at 8:00, 10:00, 12:00 and 14:00. What does the line between points help you see that separate bars would not show as clearly?
questions.prompt_cn: 一张图显示8:00、10:00、12:00和14:00的气温。把各点连接成折线，可以比独立的条形更清楚地看出什么？
questions.expected_core: It shows how the quantity changes across ordered time points and the direction/size of change.
follow_ups: Would a line graph be as suitable for favourite colours? Why?

questions.prompt_en: One sector is one quarter of a pie chart. If the chart represents 80 pupils, how many pupils are in that sector? Explain how the sector relates to the whole.
questions.prompt_cn: 一个扇形统计图中，有一个扇形占整个圆的1/4。如果全图代表80名学生，这个扇形代表多少人？请解释它和整体的关系。
questions.expected_core: 20 pupils; the sector represents one quarter of the whole 80.

questions.prompt_en: The scores are 2, 2, 8. Is the mean necessarily one of these three scores? Find the mean and explain it as equal sharing.
questions.prompt_cn: 三个分数是2、2、8。平均数一定要是原来的三个数之一吗？求出平均数，并用平均分配解释。
questions.expected_core: Mean = 4; redistribute the total 12 equally across 3 values. The mean need not be an observed value.

questions.prompt_en: Before answering a question from a chart, what four things should you check?
questions.prompt_cn: 根据统计图回答问题前，至少应该检查哪四项信息？
questions.expected_core: Check title/context, category/axis labels, units and scale/key; also check what population/time the data represent.
follow_ups: Why can the same bar height mean different values on different scales?

questions.prompt_en: A fair coin is tossed 10 times and lands heads 7 times. Does that prove the coin is unfair? Explain what might happen with more trials.
questions.prompt_cn: 一枚公平硬币抛10次，正面出现7次。这能证明硬币不公平吗？请解释增加试验次数后可能发生什么。
questions.expected_core: No. Small random samples vary; more trials can give a more stable picture of the underlying likelihood.

questions.prompt_en: For a standard six-sided die, classify these as impossible, possible or certain: rolling a 7; rolling an even number; rolling a number from 1 to 6.
questions.prompt_cn: 对于普通六面骰子，把下面事件分为“不可能、可能、一定”：掷出7；掷出偶数；掷出1到6中的一个数。
questions.expected_core: 7 is impossible; even is possible; 1-6 is certain.
